name: the configured backends are described without credentials
description: data is a list, one entry per backend, and every entry carries type, index and roles. The host key is deliberately not pinned: Elasticsearch reports "hosts" as a list because it fans out and keeps a per-host health table, while Meilisearch reports a single "host" string, and forcing them into one shape would misdescribe whichever backend lost. What is pinned is the absence of apiKey. This is a diagnostics endpoint — Phorge defines getBackends() but never calls it, and the cluster panel renders local configuration instead — and the output of a diagnostics endpoint is what gets pasted into tickets, logs and support threads, so a credential must never appear in any response here.
